description.detailed_description: This is a standard 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) tracing. The leads are labeled, including limb leads (I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF) and precordial leads (V1-V6). The tracing shows abnormal findings, including prominent QRS complexes and possible ST-segment elevations or depressions in some leads. The rhythm appears regular, but further interpretation would require clinical correlation.

description.detailed_description: This ECG tracing displays leads V1, II, and V5. The waveform shows notable abnormalities, including peaked T waves and widened QRS complexes. The rhythm appears regular, and the findings may suggest hyperkalemia or another electrolyte disturbance. The grid background and standard lead labeling are visible, indicating a standard 12-lead ECG recording.
